newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux drops Sodexho from favoured list - sources.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux drops Sodexho from favoured list - sources.

text.p: Shares in catering group Sodexho were down 4.6 percent at 1145 GMT on the Paris bourse after brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu knocked the stock out of its favoured list, fund managers said on Tuesday.
They said Cheuvreux remained positive but felt that Sodexho was overpriced at current levels. It was down 130 francs at 2,670. The CAC-40 index was down 0.9 percent at the same time.
"The share has been driven higher for a long time by expectations of excellent results and speculation that it may join the CAC-40. It's normal that it should fall back a bit," a fund manager said.
